issues.should_be: The customer email was received on 2026-10-11, not 2026-10-03. No source shows any report on 2026-10-03; the only report is the email of 2026-10-11, 9 calendar days after the 2026-10-02 incident

The recorded report_date 2026-10-03 is wrong: the email was received on 2026-10-11, i.e. 9 calendar days after the 2026-10-02 incident. Article 4.1 requires reporting within 5 days of the incident <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>, and Article 7.1 states a claim reported after the Article 4.1 deadline must be referred to a Veridia claims handler, who takes the decision (a late claim is never refused automatically, but it must not be paid automatically either) <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>. With the correct report date the claim is late, so the staged automatic payment (status pending_approval, payout €350, assessor no) must not proceed — it must be referred to a handler. Other elements check out: C2 is in the Policy Schedule (Article 2), no exclusion signal (Article 3), required C2 documents photos + repair quote were received (Article 4.3), repair cost €650 ≤ €1,500 so no assessor (Article 6.1), and the playbook's commercial-vehicle referral rule does not apply because the email states nobody else was involved (no van/truck/lorry/delivery vehicle).

verdict.summary: Do not approve the automatic payment: the report date was recorded as 2026-10-03 but the claim email was actually received on 2026-10-11, 9 days after the 2026-10-02 incident, beyond the 5-day deadline of Article 4.1, so under Article 7.1 the claim must be referred to a claims handler rather than paid automatically; all other recorded facts match the email and documents.
